# Pilot summary (auto-generated by lwti/eval/summary.py)

Criteria were fixed in the plan before results; see the module docstring.
B1–B5 (E1/E0b) were added on 16 Nov 2026, before any E1/E0b run had finished.

| Assumption | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | PASS | 4 families at least double CER at medium severity (need ≥ 2) |
| A2 | FAIL | 2 damage statistics with KS D ≥ 0.5 (need ≥ 3) |
| A3 | FAIL | no pretraining variant beats the scratch CRNN beyond the seed spread |
| A4 | PASS | derived ≤ hand-picked in 3 of 3 settings (indicative only): catmus 5%: 33.4% vs 35.0%; iam 1%: 43.9% vs 44.7%; iam 10%: 20.5% vs 21.0% |
| B1 | PASS | 6-family medium-damage CER 37.9% → 19.4% (gain 18.5 pts; need ≥ 2.0 and > seed spread 2.8) |
| B2 | pending | derived 19.4% vs hand-picked 18.9% (6-family medium-damage CER) |
| B3 | PASS | derived 19.4% vs bgnorm 32.3% (6-family medium-damage CER) |
| B4 | PASS | clean CER derived − scratch: iam 10% -1.1 pts; catmus 5% -2.2 pts (need ≤ +1.0 on both) |
| B5 | PASS | derived beats scratch beyond the seed spread on 3 of 3 (need ≥ 2): paper 35.6% → 33.0% ✓; midtone 35.7% → 32.9% ✓; contrast 39.4% → 37.0% ✓ |

## Record: first attempt with a small ViT encoder (not used for the verdicts)

The 6.5M-parameter ViT memorised the few labelled lines (training loss → 0) and its MAE features were weak at this data scale (frozen-encoder probe 75% CER). Pretraining still helped the same ViT:
